    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon loader via dynamic API resolution pattern"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC Attribution 4.0 International"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $xor_key = { 0x36 0x12 0x00 0x00 }
        $sleep_mask = "Sleep" wide ascii
        $config_search = "45 63 68 6F 20 6F 66 66" // "Echo off" in beacon config
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $xor_key and $sleep_mask and $config_search
}
